glosses: Physically resembling a labyrinth; with the qualities of a maze.

examples.text: As our train to Paris dashed through the labyrynthine flyovers at Porchefontaine, barely a mile from Versailles, the 75 m.p.h. limit was already almost attained.

glosses: Relating to the labyrinth of the inner ear.

examples.text: Mamet, like one of his characters, invents a labyrinthine, convoluted spiel leading nowhere, and like a magician distracts us with his words while elaborately not producing a rabbit from his hat.

De cette façon, on pourra différencier les syndromes labyrinthiques périphériques par atteinte du vestibule et du nerf vestibulaire, […], et les syndromes labyrinthiques radiculaires et centraux.
